name: Elvara
summary: Elvara is sculpted from hand polished alabaster, its translucent stone softly veined with natural elegance, paired with steel refined through a deep metallic finish. The pendant light exudes quiet opulence, uniting raw purity and crafted strength in a timeless silhouette. D800mm+D600mm / D800*H125mm Alabaster+Steel
